fusions.name: Staked Weir
fusions.desc: Stakes a wall 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. It deals 11 damage to each enemy that crosses it, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Oubliette
fusions.desc: A crushing strike that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lock Chamber
fusions.desc: After a 0.5-second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds, and they cannot be healed while held. Each of them then moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Easy Pickings
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying one of your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
